newsitem.title: USA: EDS lands lead in $4 bln BellSouth pact - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: EDS lands lead in $4 bln BellSouth pact - WSJ.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems won the lead role in a multiyear $4.0 billion deal to run the computer systems of BellSouth's biggest unit, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The paper said in its electronic edition that EDS will share the job with rival Andersen Consulting, although would get the largest share. Exact revenue figures could not be determined, the paper said.
A BellSouth spokeswoman confirmed the deal, the paper added. The paper also said that while the deal has not been formally announced, BellSouth is not considering any other companies.
IBM was among the companies EDS bested to land the contract, the paper said.
EDS' last megadeal -- a $1.0 billion, 10-year contract with Rolls-Royce -- was in December 1995, the paper said.
